answer: Agents can earn influence only by staking tokens that are slashed when a randomly selected audit finds fabricated identities or coordinated self-dealing. Auditors sample claims and trace payment flows, so an attacker cannot gain durable voting weight merely by creating many accounts; each account needs scarce capital at risk. A whisper campaign may recruit a quill of fresh profiles, but those profiles still require separate stakes, and linked funds expose the whole cluster to loss. The knoll of upfront capital and expected slashing makes Sybil influence costly.
